core_meaning.primary_meaning: Firuz is a Persian-origin name meaning “Victorious”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Firuz corresponds to the Persian form فيروز (Persian فیروز (Fīrūz)). Its core sense is turquoise. Firuz is a transliteration of the Persian name فیروز (Fīrūz) 'victorious', from which the name of the turquoise gem also derives. The source gloss 'turquoise' captures the gem sense; 'victorious' is the older core sense of the base word.

persian.name: فیروز
